sn35.160:1.1: This monastery belonged to the Buddha’s doctor, Jīvaka, who appears in [dn2](). His story is told in [pli-tv-kd8](), where we learn that he was raised by Prince Abhaya of Magadha, a Jain ([mn58]()) who was also interested in the teachings of Pūraṇa Kassapa ([sn46.56]()). [mn55]() on eating meat is addressed to him. | This discourse and the next are similar to [sn22.5]()–6.
